newsitem.title: UK: UK growth most sustainable in Europe - Treasury.
newsitem.headline: UK growth most sustainable in Europe - Treasury.

text.p: Britain's economy is growing at the most sustainable rate of any major European country, a Treasury spokesman said.
"With low inflation and clearly improving consumer confidence, Britain is experiencing the most balanced and sustainable economic growth of any major European economy," he said.
Earlier the government announced that August retail sales had risen a year-on-year 4.4 percent.
